title: Time travel to 14th-century Mount Athos
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of Time travel to 14th-century Mount Athos, about 1991 at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In 1991, I went on a pilgrimage to Mount Athos, Greece, and I'm sitting at this I fell asleep, sort of napping on this stone chair facing the church.
I saw that town again but back in back in the 1500s, you know, and I go there and I present my credentials so to speak at the capital
tellings.difference: Sets the past in the 1400s-1500s rather than the 14th century, and adds that he arrived as the monk Odious Maximus, presented his credentials, and that the monk Gabriel and Evagrius were involved.
tellings.link_reason: The same teller's 1991 dream on the Mount Athos pilgrimage of travelling back in time to old Mount Athos, which is the stored time-travel story.

as_told.title: Dream time travel back to 1500s Mount Athos as the monk Odious Maximus

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he once travelled back in time. He says that in 1991 he went on a pilgrimage to Mount Athos, a holy mountain in Greece, and dozed off on a stone chair facing a church. As he tells it, he then found himself in the same place centuries earlier, around the 1300s. If it were true, it would mean a person can slip out of their own time and into the past. A second telling on the same show, by a speaker called Ralph, describes seeing the town again in the 1400s or 1500s. In that version he arrived as a monk named Odious Maximus, presented his credentials at the capital, and met figures named the monk Gabriel and Evagrius. The two versions disagree on which century he reached.
